blockers.finding: batchConceptPreparationReadHash830G3 uses canonicalJSON830G2, whose encoding leaves Go JSON escapes for U+2028/U+2029. The frozen G3 canonical contract hashes the logical Unicode strings. The actual 342 preparation contains 28 U+2028 values, so the service emits a read_sha256 that the frozen UI/Python correctly rejects.
blockers.required_bounded_repair: Only the G3 preparation-read hash canonical step may marshal the typed payload and pass it to the existing exported types.CanonicalConceptMemberPayload830G2, preserving the existing G3 domain/preimage and response content. Do not modify the legacy G2 helper or use byte ReplaceAll. Add U+2028, U+2029, literal backslash-u, and TAB/LF/CR body vectors plus the actual full preparation interop check.

blockers.finding: The G3 service checks only preparationID != empty and the handler normalizes the G3 input with TrimSpace. Invalid D structured Text can therefore be accepted and stored or silently changed into another identity before admission.
blockers.required_bounded_repair: Use one service-private exact D Text predicate for G3 preparation IDs: valid UTF-8, NFC, nonempty, exactly edge-trimmed, and no U+0000..U+001F or U+007F. There is no 512 limit. Create and Load must reject before source/repository access; reopened stored ID must be strict and equal requested ID; validateBatchConceptPreparation must reject corrupt stored IDs. The G3 handler branches must pass raw decoded IDs without TrimSpace; G1/G2 behavior remains unchanged. Positive boundaries include NFC Chinese, ordinary internal space, internal U+2028/U+2029, literal backslash-u, and >512 characters within existing transport limits.
